The platform aggregates high-tension headlines—from cockpit security breaches to regional airstrikes—framing them as systematic intelligence.

The Bright Side:
It surfaces global security risks across diverse regions that mainstream news often misses or silos.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confuses WHAT (curated data) with WHO (the user's emotional vulnerability to crisis narratives).

Social Physics Analysis:
The feed runs a smart selfish loop, packaging manufactured geopolitical friction as analytical clarity to hook user attention.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Conflict curation deepens societal paralysis.

The Unavoidable Truth: Curated threat feeds amplify anxiety without offering actionable solutions.

The Unavoidable Lie: Aggregating constant global crises constitutes objective understanding.
